correctness.rationale: For coefficients a∈ℂ^n, signed-sum convex hull equals zonogon Z=Σ[-a_j,a_j] with circumradius M and perimeter 4Σ|a_j|. If there are d nonparallel generator directions modulo sign, Z has m=2d≤2n sides. Every convex m-gon inside the centered radius-M disk has perimeter ≤2mM sin(π/m) by moving genuine maximizing vertices to the circle then Jensen on central-angle gaps, equality iff regular. Since m sin(π/m) grows strictly for m≥2, Σ|a_j|/M≤n sin(π/(2n)). Equal modulus and evenly spaced directions modulo sign give regular 2n-gon and attain equality. Conversely, equality forces m=2n, all generators nonzero/nonparallel, regularity, hence precisely equal modulus and those directions. The n≥5 theorem follows without extrapolating finite tests.
residual_risks: The n≥5 coordinate complex character system only; neither arbitrary Sidon sets nor real/vector-valued analogues are claimed.
